dedupeText: gritty wartime soundtrack cover distressed war vintage splatter hand lettered grunge sepia blood red the diagonal bat creates a strong leading line from top left to bottom right the vertical leather strap anchors the helmet to the center of the bat the vibrant red title text contrasts sharply against the muted sepia and cream background splatter and stain textures unify the foreground objects with the background plane combine a central weathered object with a diagonal leading line set against a stained parchment background using aggressive red hand lettered typography for high impact visual storytelling

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, distressed composition featuring a weathered wooden baseball bat and a damaged military helmet suspended by a leather strap against a stained, parchment-like background with aggressive, hand-painted typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal bat creates a strong leading line from top-left to bottom-right.
The vertical leather strap anchors the helmet to the center of the bat.
The vibrant red title text contrasts sharply against the muted sepia and cream background.
Splatter and stain textures unify the foreground objects with the background plane.
coreInvariants: Parchment/paper texture background with coffee-like stains
Heavy distressing and grit across all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bat and helmet occupy the central and lower-right quadrants, scaled to dominate the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection where the leather strap meets the bat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, follows the bat's diagonal down to the helmet, then settles on the bottom-right metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper-right and lower-left, providing breathing room for the textured background.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and charcoal (shadows and bat details)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant blood-red (primary title and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights, punctuated by high-saturation red.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and red

letterConstructionRules: Jagged, uneven strokes mimicking thick paint or blood
Variable baseline with letters bouncing vertically
Heavy ink splatter and drip effects integrated into glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals ending in sharp points or drips
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive hand-painted display paired with a clean, elegant script and a blocky, spaced-out sans-serif.

avoid: Clean, modern sans-serifs for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, violent energy of the main title.
Provides a sophisticated contrast for secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, sepia-toned image of a scarred wooden baseball bat positioned diagonally. A dented, dirty WWII-style steel helmet hangs from the bat by a worn leather strap. The background is stained parchment with ink splatters and a subtle halftone texture in the shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, aggressive blood-red hand-painted title in the upper left at a diagonal angle. Add a white elegant script subtitle in the lower right, and a red spaced-out blocky sans-serif below it. Include a small technical metadata box in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title red and distressed?
Is the bat positioned on a clear diagonal?
Does the background look like stained, old paper?
Is the helmet visibly damaged and hanging from a strap?

mustRedesign: Exact handwriting of the director's name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the primary subject (helmet/bat intersection).
Check that the red color feels 'bloody' rather than 'neon'.
Verify the halftone pattern is subtle and only in shadow areas.
Confirm the background stains look organic and not repetitive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central weathered object with a diagonal leading line, set against a stained parchment background, using aggressive red hand-lettered typography for high-impact visual storytelling.
